'''Eker''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] trainer for the [[Crimson Phoenix Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
